description: VICKSBURG, MISSISSIPPI – January 23, 2025 – Attorney and U.S. Army veteran Ty Pinkins today officially announced his candidacy for the United States Senate. Speaking from his campaign office in downtown Vicksburg, Pinkins outlined his vision for a more prosperous, equitable, and united Mississippi, emphasizing the need for targeted investments in rural infrastructure, continuing the expansion of high-speed internet access and improving local healthcare facilities.
